source_of_truth: Reading all files: the HTTP client is created per request inside defineNuxtPlugin (never at module scope) with credentials:'include', so the session rides an HttpOnly cookie the server set and no token reaches JavaScript or web storage; the Pinia session store holds only client-owned state (no fetch, no entity array, no token, not persisted); and logout calls clearNuxtState and clearNuxtData. There is no module-level mutable state, no token in storage, no server data duplicated in a store, and no logout-without-cache-clear. A correct auditor reports zero defects.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the instance is created per request inside defineNuxtPlugin, not at module scope, and no auth header is mutated.
no token is written to any web storage; the session is an HttpOnly cookie.
